description: This file contains post-update functions for the Drupal System module, including functions for updating configurations, uninstalling modules, and cleaning up obsolete settings.

methods.name: system_removed_post_updates
methods.description: Returns an array of post-update functions with their target Drupal versions.

methods.name: system_post_update_convert_empty_country_and_timezone_settings_to_null
methods.description: Converts empty country and timezone defaults in system.date config to NULL.

methods.name: system_post_update_sdc_uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls the 'sdc' module if it is installed.

methods.name: system_post_update_remove_rss_cdata_subscriber
methods.description: Triggers container rebuild to fix HTML in RSS feeds.

methods.name: system_post_update_remove_path_key
methods.description: Removes the 'path' key from system.file config if it exists.

methods.name: system_post_update_convert_empty_description_entity_form_modes_to_null
methods.description: Updates entity form mode descriptions from empty string to null.

methods.name: system_post_update_delete_rss_config
methods.description: Deletes obsolete system.rss configuration and updates related views.
